_help: Things the siblings decide together with a vote. rule can be unanimous, majority or optin (only the siblings who vote yes take part; needs at least min yes votes). crime: true shows it in the heist section. who = which siblings are involved (and vote), checked per sibling. min = how many involved siblings are needed. cond = family condition. rule = unanimous or majority (the host can change it in the lobby). cooldown = years before it can be voted again. Outcome 'each' applies to every involved sibling; 'family' changes the family; sib_rel_all changes relationships between the involved siblings; rel_parents changes how they get along with their parents. handler = special code in game.py.
